verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Logs page that can be filtered and exported as CSV or JSON (docs-23), plus spend/usage/observability metrics logging (docs-36, docs-12, docs-30), which supports basic manual export of request logs. However there is no evidence of native integration with external observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, webhooks, Datadog/Grafana streaming, or a traces API) for automated ingestion into a developer's own tooling. Missing for 10: OpenTelemetry/webhook-based trace export, third-party observability integrations, automated/streaming log delivery beyond manual CSV/JSON download.
